entries.name: The Long Dry
entries.text: Every dry season the wells of the cinder wastes run out and the Horde marches. The Wardens call it the Long Dry, and keep a tally of how many they have survived.

entries.name: Keep One Fire Lit
entries.text: The first Warden swore never to let the keep's hearth go cold. The Wardens say the Horde fears the glow more than the steel.
